words.matches.title: Ranked Games
words.matches.lede: Every match played by a team in the {poll}, day by day.
words.matches.lede_d1: Every Division I match, day by day.
words.rankings.title: Top 25 Rankings
words.rankings.lede_goat: This site's own ranking of every Division I team. The top 25 are the same 25 teams as the AVCA poll, put in order by the poll itself (half the score), strength of schedule, strength of record and head to head; every other team follows from 26 the same way.
words.rankings.frozen: Final for the season: frozen at the end of the regular season.
words.rankings.lede_conf: Every conference, strongest first. Inside a conference, teams are in order of their record in conference games.
words.rankings.note: Record and change are from the poll, which is checked for a new one every Monday. Choose a team to see its page.
words.rankings.note_goat: Beside each team are its results this season against the GOAT top 25, with their GOAT places. The AVCA column is the team's place in the coaches poll; a dash means it is not ranked there. Redone every night.
words.teams.title: Top 25 Team Stats
words.teams.lede: How each ranked team attacks, serves, blocks and defends, per set, and what its opponents manage against it. From official box scores.
words.teams.lede_d1: How every Division I team attacks, serves, blocks and defends, per set, and what its opponents manage against it. From official box scores.
words.team.players_note: # is her rank by Impact per set among all regulars on the 25 ranked teams; part-time players are greyed and not ranked. Choose a name for her card.
words.team.players_note_d1: # is her rank by Impact per set among all regulars in Division I; part-time players are greyed and not ranked. Choose a name for her card.
words.players.title: Top Players
words.players.lede: Every regular on a ranked team, ranked against the rest by Impact per set: the points she adds per set over an average top-25 player at her position.
words.players.lede_d1: Every regular in Division I, ranked against the rest by Impact per set: the points she adds per set over an average Division I player at her position.
words.players.career_note: Each season's line is added up from that season's box scores. A player who changed schools starts again at her new one.
words.players.career_wait: Only this season so far: her earlier seasons at this school are still being read, a few thousand box scores at a time, and will appear here within a few days.
words.pro.players_career_note: Each season's line is added up from the league's own match statistics. A player who changed teams has a line for each.
words.pro.rankings_lede_goat: This site's own ranking of the {league} teams: its place in the standings (half the score), strength of schedule, strength of record and head to head.
words.pro.rankings_note_goat: Every team is ranked on four things: its place in the standings (50%), strength of schedule (20%: how good the teams it has played are, on average), strength of record (20%: a win counts for more the better the team beaten, a loss costs more the weaker the team lost to), and head to head (10%: a team is ranked above one it has the better of when the two are that close on the rest). SOR and SOS are shown out of 100. Playoff matches count.
words.pro.rankings_note: LOVB teams are placed by wins; MLV teams by points (3 for a win in three or four sets, 2 for a win in five, 1 for a loss in five), as in the league's own table. Ties go to share of matches won, then sets won to sets lost; play-off matches do not count. Choose a team to see its page.
words.pro.teams_lede: How each {league} team attacks, serves, blocks and defends, per set, and what its opponents manage against it.
words.pro.team_players_note: # is her rank by Impact per set among all {league} regulars; part-time players are greyed and not ranked. Choose a name for her card.
words.pro.players_lede: Every regular in the {league}, ranked by Impact per set: the points she adds per set over an average {league} player at her position.
words.games.odds_short: These percentages are this site's own estimate of each team's chance of winning, not betting lines.
